title: Debounce a button with an RC
story: A button pulls an input pin to ground; a 10 kohm pull-up brings it back up when released. The contacts bounce for up to 5 ms. Add a capacitor from the pin to ground so that, after release, the pin does not reach the logic-1 threshold of 1.98 V before 5 ms, but does reach it within 50 ms. At t = 0 the button has just been released and the capacitor is empty.

goals.label: pin crosses 1.98 V between 5 ms and 50 ms after release

hints: The pin charges like v(t) = 3.3 x (1 - e^(-t / RC)).
1.98 V is 60% of 3.3 V, reached at t = RC x ln(2.5) = 0.916 RC.
Compute RC for each capacitor with R = 10 kohm.
